title: Control flow, loops and gas limits
why: Unbounded loops behave differently under EVM gas metering vs Substrate weight metering: an out-of-gas on EVM may succeed (or fail differently) on pallet-contracts. Status asymmetries here reveal metering-model mismatches.
hints: Loops bounded by a caller-supplied count (small values! the oracle has tx timeouts).
Early returns from deep nesting, break/continue in nested loops.
try/catch around an internal revert (external calls need a second contract — avoid; use internal errors instead).
